title: 第2章 恩爱夫妻
slug: 江南第一媳全本免费-江南第一媳最新章节列表
content_zh:
收两文钱是尊重，若白送的话，不是亵渎人家读书人？老汉很懂人情世故的，知道读书人最要脸面。
梁心铭坦然接过簪子，将女儿放下来，又在怀里掏，掏了几下，才掏出两文钱，递给老汉，“谢老伯。”
老汉笑道：“这是公子买的，谢我做什么。”
梁心铭也不辩解，道：“老伯善心会得到福报的。”
老汉笑道：“真的？我孙子也念书呢。将来就指望他了。若是能像公子一样考秀才，我死了也闭眼了。”
梁心铭道：“老伯定能心想事成。”
老汉笑得脸上皱纹挤在一块，犹如菊花盛开，还想跟他说道说道自己孙子读书情况，想要听几句“金玉良言”，可是梁心铭已经转过身，对李惠娘道：“来，我帮你戴上。”
李惠娘呆呆看着梁心铭，眼睛蓦然就红了。
梁心铭扶正她肩膀，将她头上的花布巾取下，仔细端详审视她，看把簪子插在什么位置合适。
头巾取下，李惠娘的容颜增添了三分光彩。她生就的白腻肤色，圆脸尖下巴，柳叶眉、丹凤眼，鼻子小巧，红唇丰盈，很水润的江南女儿。只是荆钗布裙，看着不打眼。若打扮起来，怕是差不多的大户人家小姐也比不上她。
可因为夫君是温润读书君子，她家里家外的操持，就不免强势了些。强势惯了，就在面上留下了痕迹：一双丹凤眼光芒锐利，张嘴就如砍瓜切菜，跟温柔不沾边。
这是个泼辣的小媳妇！
梁心铭看了一会，才将簪子斜插入发髻，梅花正对外。
“好了。”他笑吟吟道。
“你哪来的钱？”李惠娘小声问。
“在贡院捡的。”梁心铭道。
李惠娘凤眼差点瞪圆了。
梁心铭弯腰抱起女儿，道：“回家吧。”说罢转身对老汉告辞，说等放榜之日在此为他写字。
老汉连连道谢，好像梁心铭已经高中榜首一样；又把他夫妻一扫，夸赞道：“公子疼媳妇，是个有情义的。”
李惠娘笑容灿烂道：“也是他多事。谁没个穷的时候？买不起就不买。若有那个命，真中了解元、状元，那将来一副字画值多少银子？买什么首饰买不起呢！现在要老伯让这么多利，太心急了，倒叫老伯笑话，说我们不踏实。”

老汉一听急了，忙道：“那不一样！现在买的情义不一样！将来买再多，也比不上他今天买给你的心意。我怎么敢笑话你们呢？我是沾了大光了！”
他看出李惠娘是个本分媳妇，生怕她后悔，把簪子不要了，那他就不能在放榜之日求梁心铭为他写字了。这可是“解元”的字！虽然尚未落定，但他相信梁心铭一定能中，甚至将来还能中状元，那他可赚大了。怎么能反悔呢？
老汉有些愧疚，想要再找补一样东西给他们夫妻。
李惠娘为夫君争回了脸面，点醒老伯：是他占了他们的便宜，而非他们沾他的光。然后她见好就收，很是优越地拒绝了老汉的找补，说道：“怎好再要呢？老伯做的小本买卖，我夫君读书人，最重品行，不敢欺骗老人家。若非老人家慧眼识明珠，这笔买卖也做不成。这已经很破例了，毕竟夫君还没中呢。老伯知道，这考试也是有门道的！”
最后一句话她压低了声音，说的意味深长，言下之意：梁心铭若没考上，定有内情，不是他没能力。
老汉连连点头，人情世故他通透：这世道，没权没钱，光有才能是不行的。但他还是很看好梁心铭，再三安慰李惠娘，说她的夫君定能高中，将来必然大富大贵。
李惠娘笑道：“借老伯吉言。”
老汉也再三谢他们给脸面。
李惠娘大度地说不用谢，然后利落地转身，结束了这场满含机锋的买卖交谈，却发现梁心铭正含笑看着她，有些戏谑，又像纵容，不由尴尬，忙挽起他胳膊就走，嘴里说：“走吧，明天还要考呢。晚上要早些歇才好。”
梁心铭却立定脚步，不肯走了。
她对老汉道：“老伯就不怕在下落榜？”
老汉忙道：“这不可能……”哎呀，这人说话好不吉利，哪有在这时候说这样晦气话的！

content_en:
Charging two pennies is respect, but if you give it away for free, isn't it blasphemy as a scholar? The old man is very understanding of human nature and knows that scholars value face the most.
Liang Xinming calmly took the hairpin, put his daughter down, dug in his arms again, took out two pennies, and handed it to the old man, "Thank you, uncle."
The old man smiled and said: "Young master bought this, thank me for anything."
Liang Xinming did not defend himself and said, "My kindness will be rewarded."
The old man smiled and said: "Really? My grandson is also studying. I will count on him in the future. If he can be a scholar like the young master, I will close my eyes even after I die."
Liang Xinming said: "I will definitely be able to make all my wishes come true."
The old man smiled so that the wrinkles on his face were squeezed together, like chrysanthemums in full bloom. He also wanted to tell him about his grandson's study status, and wanted to hear a few "good words", but Liang Xinming had already turned around and said to Li Huiniang: "Here, I will put it on for you."
Li Huiniang looked at Liang Xinming blankly, her eyes suddenly turned red.
Liang Xinming straightened her shoulders, took off the floral shawl on her head, and looked at her carefully to see where the hairpin should be inserted.
After taking off the headscarf, Li Huiniang's face became even more radiant. She was born with a fair complexion, a round face and a pointed chin, willow-leaf eyebrows, red phoenix eyes, a small nose, and plump red lips, making her a very moist girl from the south of the Yangtze River. It's just Jingchai's sarong, which doesn't look eye-catching. If she were to dress up, I'm afraid even the ladies from similar rich families wouldn't be able to compare to her.
But because her husband is a gentle scholar, her management at home and outside is inevitably a little more forceful. He was used to being strong, and it left traces on his face: a pair of phoenix eyes with sharp light, and opening his mouth was like chopping melons and vegetables, which had nothing to do with gentleness.
This is a fierce little daughter-in-law!
Liang Xinming looked at it for a while, then inserted the hairpin diagonally into her bun, with the plum blossoms facing outward.
"Okay." He said with a smile.
"Where did you get the money?" Li Huiniang asked quietly.
"I picked it up in Gongyuan." Liang Xinming said.
Li Huiniang's eyes almost widened.
Liang Xinming bent down and picked up his daughter and said, "Go home." After that, he turned around and said goodbye to the old man, saying that he would write for him here when the results are released.
The old man thanked her again and again, as if Liang Xinming had topped the list in high school; he then swept the couple away and praised: "The young master loves his wife and is a caring person."
Li Huiniang smiled brightly and said: "It's because he is troublesome. Who is poor? If you can't afford it, don't buy it. If you are destined to get the first prize or the first prize, how much silver will a piece of calligraphy and painting be worth in the future? What kind of jewelry can't be bought! Now I want to give up so much profit. I am too impatient. I make a joke and say that we are not practical."
When the old man heard this, he became anxious and said hurriedly: "That's different! The sentiment of buying now is different! No matter how much you buy in the future, it won't be as good as what he bought you today. How dare I laugh at you? I've got a lot of money!"
He saw that Li Huiniang was a dutiful wife, and he was afraid that she would regret it and give up the hairpin, so he could not ask Liang Xinming to write for him on the day when the results were released. This is the word "Jie Yuan"! Although it has not yet been decided, he believes that Liang Xinming will definitely win, and even win the top prize in the future, then he will make a lot of money. How can you regret it?
The old man felt a little guilty and wanted to find something else to give to the couple.
Li Huiniang regained her husband's face and reminded the old man: it was he who took advantage of them, not them who took advantage of him. Then she accepted the offer and rejected the old man's offer very superiorly, saying, "How can I ask for it again? My husband is a scholar in this small business, and he has the highest moral character. He dare not deceive the old man. If the old man had not seen the pearls, this business would not have been completed. This is already an exception, after all, my husband has not won yet. The old man knows that there is a way to take this exam!"
She lowered her voice in the last sentence and said it with profound meaning: If Liang Xinming failed to pass the exam, there must be something inside. It's not that he is incapable.
The old man nodded repeatedly. He was very understanding of the world: In this world, there is no right or no power.Money, talent alone is not enough. But he was still very optimistic about Liang Xinming, and repeatedly comforted Li Huiniang, saying that her husband would definitely be able to go to high school and become rich in the future.
Li Huiniang smiled and said, "I'm borrowing my old uncle's good advice."
The old man also thanked them again and again for their face.
Li Huiniang graciously said no thank you, and then turned around neatly to end the sharp business conversation. She found Liang Xinming looking at her with a smile, a bit joking, but also conniving. She couldn't help but feel embarrassed. She quickly took his arm and left, saying: "Let's go, we have to take the exam tomorrow. It's better to rest early in the evening."
However, Liang Xinming stood firm and refused to leave.
She said to the old man: "Aren't you afraid of failing the exam?"
The old man said hurriedly: "This is impossible..." Oh, this man's words are so unlucky. How could anyone say such unlucky words at this time!
